textbookBox.concept: Goods and services reach people, households and businesses through markets. Every market has a buyer and a seller. A buyer has a want, something they need or desire, and is willing and able to pay.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Goods and services reach people, households and businesses through markets. Every market has a buyer and a seller. A buyer has a want, something they need or desire, and is willing and able to pay.
beats.speakEn: Goods and services reach people, households and businesses through markets. Every market has a buyer and a seller. A buyer has a want, something they need or desire, and is willing and able to pay.

beats.en: The price is the amount of money a buyer pays for a good or service. Prices are generally determined by the interaction of demand from buyers and supply by sellers.
beats.speakEn: The price is the amount of money a buyer pays for a good or service. Prices are generally determined by the interaction of demand from buyers and supply by sellers.

textbookBox.concept: A physical market is where buyers can meet sellers in person, for vegetables, clothes, phones, medicines and more. Some services, like a haircut, need physical presence.

beats.en: A wholesaler buys goods in large quantities from the producer or manufacturer and stores them in large warehouses.
